[1. opinion] [2. size] [3. age] [4. shape] [5. color] [6. origin] [7. material] [8. purpose] noun.  
Adjectives should appear in this sequence for correct grammatical order.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:  
Options:  
(A) rubber terrible ship  
(B) terrible rubber ship

When multiple adjectives appear before a noun, they should follow the order: [1. opinion] [2. size] [3. age] [4. shape] [5. color] [6. origin] [7. material] [8. purpose] noun.

Option (B): "terrible rubber ship". "terrible" is an opinion (1), "rubber" is a material (7). The order is [1] [7], which is correct because 1 < 7.  
So the answer is (B).
